3: From the ends of the earth have I cried to you, when my heart was in trouble: you lifted me up on a rock you did guide me:
4: because you were my hope, a tower of strength from the face of the enemy.
5: I will dwell in your tabernacle for ever; I will shelter myself under the shadow of your wings. Pause.
6: For you, o God, have heard my prayers; you have given an inheritance to them that fear your name.
7: You shall add days to the days of the king; [you shall lengthen] his years to all generations.
8: He shall endure for ever before God: which of them will seek out his mercy and truth?
9: So will I sing to your name for ever and ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
